question: Do the already-frozen, strategy-independent trend-direction and new-high/new-low discovery representations describe CHINEXT V1 opportunity generation, admission conversion, or completed-cycle payoff shape without optimizing a trading rule?
non_claims: No market representation is presumed to be a trading signal or causal mechanism.
No state boundary is an entry gate, veto, exposure overlay, or strategy recommendation.
No result may be called untouched out-of-sample evidence.
No result is required to improve CHINEXT V1.

breadth_panel.selector: market_view == CHINEXT_BOARD and denominator == ALL_STATUS and view_valid == true
breadth_panel.neighboring_denominator: CHINEXT_BOARD/NON_ST is a fixed sensitivity only

time_and_pit_contract.research_window: intersection of valid frozen state rows, 2018-07-03 through 2023-12-29
time_and_pit_contract.strategy_state_join: entry signal date equals market trade_date
time_and_pit_contract.market_available_at: must be <= strategy signal decision time and exactly the same completed close
time_and_pit_contract.execution: entry_execution_date must be strictly later than entry_signal_date
time_and_pit_contract.unknown_lineage_or_missing_state: fail closed; no interpolation or proxy index/view substitution
time_and_pit_contract.post_2023: unavailable from the frozen market-state panels and excluded, not backfilled
time_and_pit_contract.pit_grade: bounded PIT-B inherited from the frozen CHINEXT and CY-006 contracts

B_breadth_discovery.distinction_from_old_H004: This is frozen 40/60/80-session new-high/new-low discovery. It is not the prior CHINEXT breadth-above-MA20/positive-return20/change20 composite.

diagnostic_cells.purpose: coarse economic diagnostics only; zero was not validated as an optimal habitat boundary

strategy_process_definitions.evaluated_opportunity: one ENTRY_SIGNAL_EVALUATED event; the engine already established price_structure_pass and excluded committed/forced-exit names
strategy_process_definitions.admissible_candidate: evaluated event with minvol.passed == true and a non-null rs object
strategy_process_definitions.selected_admission: symbol added in a same-date DESIRED_SET_CHANGED event
strategy_process_definitions.calendar_denominator: all 1,337 common valid market-state dates, including zero-event dates
strategy_process_definitions.zero_day_limitation: A zero observed count can mean no qualifying structure or that the engine's market-exit branch suppressed entry evaluation; it is observed V1 opportunity generation, not latent technical-pattern incidence.

fixed_payoff_definitions.mfe: frozen observable MFE through actual exit
fixed_payoff_definitions.mae: frozen observable MAE through actual exit
fixed_payoff_definitions.positive_pnl_concentration: share of positive realized PnL contributed by the top 20 positive-PnL completed cycles in the analysis sample

analyses.continuous_primary: Spearman association of absolute A and B with each process/payoff endpoint, plus partial-rank A|B and B|A; no window or cutoff search
analyses.uncertainty: 2,000 deterministic signal-date cluster bootstrap resamples, seed 20260830, percentile 90% interval

nested_models.comparison: sample-identical OLS/LPM adjusted R-squared and coefficient diagnostics; no fitted model is an executable predictor

samples.daily_process: all common valid market dates for evaluated/candidate/selected counts
samples.event_conversion: evaluated events for candidate and selected flags; selected-among-candidate separately
samples.completed_cycle_payoff: selected admissions reconciling one-to-one to frozen completed cycles and valid same-date state

temporal_stability.year_cells: 2018 through 2023; endpoint-year cells below 20 observations are INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
temporal_stability.leave_one_year_out: report sign counts for every continuous primary with adequate remaining sample

analyses.neighbor_sensitivity: repeat primary B associations with CHINEXT_BOARD/NON_ST breadth; this cannot replace a failed ALL_STATUS primary
analyses.right_tail_and_failure: report winner20/winner50, opportunity/conversion, positive-PnL concentration, false-breakout, severe-loss10, and extreme-loss20 for every adequately populated diagnostic cell and temporal block

fixed_evidence_gates.single_coordinate_association: absolute full-sample rho >= 0.10, 90% cluster-bootstrap interval excludes zero, both temporal-block rhos have the same sign with abs(rho) >= 0.05, and at least four eligible year cells have that sign
fixed_evidence_gates.A_plus_B_incrementality: A+B adjusted R-squared exceeds max(A,B) by >= 0.01 in the full sample and both temporal blocks, and the interaction coefficient has the same sign in both blocks with a full-sample 90% cluster-bootstrap interval excluding zero
fixed_evidence_gates.habitat_supported: at least one frozen coordinate passes the single-coordinate gate for an opportunity-process or payoff endpoint; wording remains exploratory association
fixed_evidence_gates.no_rescue: A failed coordinate, sample, boundary, or endpoint is not replaced by a better-looking neighbor or cutoff in this experiment
